messages.subject: init section: looping over sets of outcomes rather than individual outcomes
parts:
Hi 
I am very new to MplusAutomation, in fact i started today with a very silly exercise fitting six multivariate regressions with three outcomes each one. I am having problems trying to figure out how to loop over  six sets of three outcomes in order to create six inp files.  

Below is an example of the one of the six inp files i want to create (the other 5 will be different only in the three outcomes, instead of using ppvtst1, ppvtst2 and ppvtst3; i will use letst1, letst2 and letst3; and so on... any advice will be greatly appreciated.

thank you
Fernando
p.s. below the inp file you will fine the template that i wrote and does NOT work


///mplus inp


Data:
  File is thumb.dat ;
Variable:
  Names are 
     childid classid sample21 sample32 female ppvtrt1 ppvtst1 ppvtrt2 ppvtst2
     agewj1 letwj1 letst1 spewj1 spest1 mthwj1 mthst1 memwj1 memst1 pairwj1
     pairst1 htks1 agewj2 letwj2 letst2 spewj2 spest2 mthwj2 mthst2 memwj2
     memst2 pairwj2 pairst2 htks2 pvtsgn21 letsgn21 spesgn21 mthsgn21 memsgn21
     pairsgn21 pairwgn21 memwgn21 htksgn21 risk1 risk2 risk3 risk4 risk5
     risk6 risk7 risk8 riskn risknc risk1_6 risk1_6b ppvtrt3 ppvtst3 agewj3
     mthwj3 mthst3 letwj3 letst3 memwj3 memst3 pairwj3 pairst3 htks3 classidt3
     gradet3 mthsgn32 letsgn32 memsgn32 pairsgn32 memwgn32 pairwgn32 exctwg32
     exctwg21 samplep agem1 agem2 agem3 age1 age2 age3 samplep3 samplep2
     risk156 shift ppvtgsv1 ppvtgsv2 ppvtgsv3;
usevariables are ppvtst1 ppvtst2 ppvtst3 risk6 classid;

 Missing are all (-9999) ; 

Analysis: 
estimator = ml;

MODEL:

ppvtst1 ppvtst2 ppvtst3 ON risk6 (b1-b3);
ppvtst1 with ppvtst2 ppvtst3; 
ppvtst2 with ppvtst3; 


[ppvtst1-ppvtst3] (i1-i3);

 
OUTPUT: standardized;


//



what i wrote for the inp templates is:

//

[[init]]

iterators = outcome ;
outcome = 1:6;
outcomenames#outcome= ppvtst letst mthst pairst htks memst;

dir = "/Users/fernandoandradeadaniya/Documents/data";

#wave names are with respect to the outcome iterator

w1name#outcome = ppvtst1 ppvtst2 ppvtst3;
w2name#outcome = letst1 letst2 letst3;
w3name#outcome = mthst1 mthst2 mthst3;
w4name#outcome = pairst1 pairst2 pairst3;
w5name#outcome = htks1 htks2 htks3;
w6name#outcome = memst1 memst2 memst3;

filename = "[[outcomenames#outcome]].inp";
outputDirectory = [[dir]];

[[/init]]

TITLE: [[outcomenames#outcome]] ;

Data:
  File is thumb.dat ;
Variable:
  Names are 
     childid classid sample21 sample32 female ppvtrt1 ppvtst1 ppvtrt2 ppvtst2
     agewj1 letwj1 letst1 spewj1 spest1 mthwj1 mthst1 memwj1 memst1 pairwj1
     pairst1 htks1 agewj2 letwj2 letst2 spewj2 spest2 mthwj2 mthst2 memwj2
     memst2 pairwj2 pairst2 htks2 pvtsgn21 letsgn21 spesgn21 mthsgn21 memsgn21
     pairsgn21 pairwgn21 memwgn21 htksgn21 risk1 risk2 risk3 risk4 risk5
     risk6 risk7 risk8 riskn risknc risk1_6 risk1_6b ppvtrt3 ppvtst3 agewj3
     mthwj3 mthst3 letwj3 letst3 memwj3 memst3 pairwj3 pairst3 htks3 classidt3
     gradet3 mthsgn32 letsgn32 memsgn32 pairsgn32 memwgn32 pairwgn32 exctwg32
     exctwg21 samplep agem1 agem2 agem3 age1 age2 age3 samplep3 samplep2
     risk156 shift ppvtgsv1 ppvtgsv2 ppvtgsv3;
     
usevariables are [[w1name#outcome]] [[w2name#outcome]] [[w3name#outcome]]
 [[w4name#outcome]][[w5name#outcome]][[w6name#outcome]]
 risk6 ;
 Missing are all (-9999) ; 
 
Analysis: 
estimator = ml;

MODEL:

[[outcomenames#outcome]] ON risk6 (b1-b3);

[[[outcomenames#outcome]]] (i1-i3);


//
